activity_definition: Original majority activity within each 8-second window, not a new sample-level activity classification.
main_results: No participants, windows, seeds, checkpoint choices or aggregate study results were changed.
original_v5_group_selection_rule: S8: largest deterioration nontransient activity, n>=50; other participant: largest improvement nontransient person/activity, n>=50. Within each selected cell choose window whose five-seed mean absolute-error difference is closest to its cell median; ties by subject, activity, window. Context fixed at +/-30 original window IDs within same subject.
rationale: Show a low-error excerpt for the better model in each of the previously selected adverse/favorable participant-activity groups. The objective differs explicitly by panel, so these are selected illustrations, not representative or unbiased estimates of performance.
rule: Retain the V5 S8 and S14 walking groups, seed 3001 and endpoint 40. Enumerate every contiguous set of 57 original 8-second windows (2-second step), all labelled walking. Select the minimum clipped-prediction segment MAE for PPG-only in S8 and feature fusion in S14; exact ties take the earliest start window. Retain all three model traces without smoothing.
selection_precision: float64 MAE from archived float32 labels and predictions; no rounded scores used
time_definition: The union of 57 windows covers exactly 120 seconds: 56*2+8. Points are placed at window centers 4,6,...,116 seconds within the segment. Start-time and center-time spans are 112 seconds; the underlying input coverage is 120 seconds.
